source_range_screen.Vaughan1998I: Theorem 1 assumes uniform Criterion-U equation (1.6) and sums q<=Q with x^(2/3)<=Q<=x; Q=f is outside the range, while a larger Q loses the prescribed-f scale and retains the strong prior hypothesis.
source_range_screen.Vaughan1998II: Theorems 1--2 assume uniform equation (1.4), mean square (1.5), and Q>sqrt(x)log(2x) for a q<=Q cumulative variance; Q=f is outside the range.
source_range_screen.Harper2024: Theorems 1--2 sum Q/2<q<=Q and require sqrt(2x)<Q<=x, so no allowed dyadic block contains f<=U^(1/21).
source_range_screen.Thorner_Zaman: Pointwise PNT can supply the endpoint norm structurally, but the implied multiplier, decay constant, exceptional branch, and common numerical cutoff remain unresolved in the fixed exponent range.

sufficient_transfer.meaning: Only a centered pointwise error at the single large endpoint U remains analytic; no mixed-covariance theorem is required for this sufficient route.

not_claimed: The centered endpoint error epsilon_infinity is numerically small.
A one-sided PAP lower bound is sufficient for the centered two-sided endpoint norm.

The Thorner--Zaman implied constants have been recovered.
No other literature or direct dispersion proof can close the endpoint gate.
PAP-11, DEP-R09, fixed 2e-17, or numerical X_cert is closed.
